prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D anime mecha game sprite atlas, transparent background.
Reference image 1 is the design identity of ASTRAYON. Create a NEW detailed hand-drawn anime mechanical illustration sheet, not a copy of the poster. Preserve its tall realistic mecha proportions, intricate angular white armor, navy chest, twin gold chest vents, gold V-fin, red forehead/chin/crotch, cyan eyes and cyan chest core, navy feet, angular white/navy shield. Remove all lettering, insignia and brands.
Composition: square canvas, exact 2 by 2 equal grid of FOUR separate full-body illustrations of this SAME machine. Each character entirely contained inside its quadrant with generous clear transparent gutters and no overlap. No visible grid, no numbers, no text. Each figure points and attacks toward screen RIGHT, viewed from front three-quarter; tall lithe limbs, small head, no chibi or toy proportions.
TOP LEFT: ready hover, legs slightly bent at different heights, rifle held lowered, shield alongside left forearm.
TOP RIGHT: two hands aiming a long dark beam rifle horizontally RIGHT, dynamic braced pose, legs extended backward slightly, shield mounted on forearm. No beam or muzzle effects.
BOTTOM LEFT: accelerating toward right, forward leaning torso almost diagonal, left knee high, trailing right leg, narrow cyan beam saber in right hand pulled back ready to swing, shield on other arm. No trails or speed lines.
BOTTOM RIGHT: powerful saber strike follow-through toward RIGHT, torso twisted, saber arm fully sweeping, legs counterbalanced, shield back. The cyan saber is modest length fully inside cell.
Style: premium dramatic Japanese mecha anime key animation, precise inked panel lines, deliberate hard cel shadows, refined metallic edge accents and restrained surface wear. NOT a simple geometric vector drawing, not photorealistic plastic, not 3D toy render. Strong white armor highlights and cool blue shadows, clear silhouette. Each drawing should have the same level of fine mechanical detail as the reference. Actual transparent alpha backdrop. No backdrop, shadows on ground, labels, words, decorative borders, lens flare or blast effects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium 2D anime mecha game sprite atlas on actual transparent alpha.
Reference image is OBSIDIAN's identity. Draw NEW anime key animation art of that same machine. Preserve tall realistic limbs, narrow waist, small head, intricate angular graphite black armor, sharp crimson edge details, red eyes and core, long black/red wing-like backpack binders. Ignore all text, insignia and human characters from reference.
Square canvas EXACT TWO BY TWO equal grid, FOUR separate full-body images, generous transparent gutters, each image completely inside its own quadrant. No visible grid or labels. All four point toward screen LEFT, front-three-quarter view, not mirrored duplicates.
TOP LEFT: alert zero-gravity ready pose, legs bent asymmetrically, long dark rifle lowered in right hand, towering two spiked binders behind shoulders.
TOP RIGHT: defensive braced pose, left forearm raised to intercept an approaching shot from the LEFT, rifle held back, feet angled.
BOTTOM LEFT: lunging attack toward LEFT, torso leaned left, right hand thrusting long crimson energy saber toward LEFT, left arm back; dynamic knee bend and trailing leg. Saber fully inside cell.
BOTTOM RIGHT: recoiling from a hit received from LEFT, torso twisting away, arms thrown wide, one shoulder visibly chipped, legs lifted, a few small armor fragments close to body, no explosion or smoke.
Style: mature high-budget mecha anime mechanical drawings with meticulous inked armor panel lines, crisp cel shading, cool steel rim light so black armor remains readable, red edge reflections. Coherent anatomy, same identity every cell, detail density like the reference. No toy, no chibi, no simple polygons, no vector cartoon, no photorealistic 3D. No background, words, markings, decorative text, flares, borders, ground shadows. Actual transparent background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ultrawide background painting for 2D anime mecha tactical battle.
Create a NEW 16:9 cinematic environment based on the orbital ruin atmosphere and blue/crimson lighting of the reference. No mecha or people anywhere. View floating in space near a ruined orbital city: a vast curved blue planet fills the lower background; a broken ring station lies diagonally across the distant center, ruined metal trusses at far left and far right, tiny suspended debris with believable scale. Calm deep navy space dominates upper half, restrained thin cyan atmosphere light from lower left, a distant dying red fire on upper right. The central 70% must remain uncluttered and dark enough for separately composited white and black mecha silhouettes. Rich architectural detail at the edges, long cinematic depth, hand-painted mature anime backgrounds with clean structural linework, volumetric haze, restrained film grain, no oversaturated bloom. No text, no lettering, no logos, no UI, no panels, no borders. 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080 or higher.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one premium anime impact keyframe for a mecha battle game, full-frame 16:9.
Use image1 for the white/blue ASTRAYON design and image2 for black/crimson OBSIDIAN. Create an original extreme dynamic combat shot, NOT a poster or model sheet. Low-angle close action composition: ASTRAYON dominates lower LEFT, twisting into a powerful diagonal cyan energy sword strike; OBSIDIAN dominates upper RIGHT, meeting it with a red energy saber. Both mecha clearly recognizable: tall intricate armored proportions, gold V-fin navy torso white armor and cyan sensors versus black spiked armor crimson sensors and tall sharp binders. The two blades meet at the central upper-middle in a small very bright white-gold contact point. Their bodies occupy most of frame and create a strong diagonal, perspective foreshortening, visible hands gripping their weapons. Fine sparks arc sideways, fragments scatter behind them, hard rim lighting. Background distant blue planetary curve and dark orbital wreckage, very soft and subordinate. Hand-inked cinematic anime key animation, expressive confident linework, detailed engineering, deep cel shadows, restrained painterly textures, subtle motion smears only on trailing limbs. No childish shapes, no toy render. No pilots, no human faces, no text, no credits, no logos, no watermarks, no borders. Strong depth and scale. Landscape 16:9.
